scope: AI workflow pre-harness gate before 8x15 Agent Review Summary LLM evaluation

evidence: prediction-result-batch.schema.json accepts results[].explanation with top_factors, confidence_label, explanation_method, feature_snapshot_ref, sensor_window_ref, display_labels, and checksum-backed source_ref values
ProductResultMaterializationService promotes generator explanation top_factors into Product Result top_factors, ranked_factor_evidence, and evidence_payload.source_fields
Agent Review Packet exposes trusted model expressions through model_expression_context and keeps raw Generator payloads out of the LLM prompt
tests/test_prediction_result_inbox.py covers optional Generator explanation absorption
remaining_before_120_run: Include at least one Generator explanation case in the 8-case Agent Review Packet gold set

adopt_when: unstructured or multi-version SOP documents enter runtime
retrieval context precision and recall become release gates
retrieved chunks carry source_sha256 and freshness metadata
retrieval results are bound to the Agent Review Packet snapshot
LLM summary validation rejects uncited retrieval claims

evidence: run_langgraph_tool_pipeline executes the same read-only trajectory when LangGraph is installed or records fallback_to_simple when unavailable
tool trajectory validation forbids closed_loop mutation tools and source refs outside packet scope

required_after_merge: merge or rebase main into codex/pr156-ai-workflow-preharness
verify cost-basis and RecommendationInput snapshot guard use the same trusted Product Result/Evidence basis
rerun maintenance loop, Agent Review Packet, and Agent Review Summary regression tests

limits: This artifact opens LangGraph and RAG-family decision gates; it does not claim production GraphRAG, Vector DB, LlamaIndex, or LangGraph watcher adoption.
The 120-run LLM evaluation should remain blocked until PR #154 is merged into main and rechecked, or the report explicitly marks the dependency as blocked_by_pr_154.
Generator expression coverage is implementation-supported but still needs explicit inclusion in the 8-case gold set before live 120-run claims.
